candidate_program.name: strongest_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Combines normalized margin over the strongest rival with a small neighborhood capture term. Reach is local and arithmetic is constant-size; several jointly feasible rivals can invalidate the single-rival proxy.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
